caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden clock case with prominent decorative elements. The case is vertically oriented and consists of three main sections arranged from top to bottom. At the very top, there is a golden eagle with outstretched wings sitting on a semi-circular platform, with scroll-like accents at each end. Below this, the largest section features a clock face; the clock face is white with black Roman numerals, ornate black hour and minute hands, and a circular gold and black center. The corners of the clock face have pink roses with green leaves. The frame surrounding the clock face has vertical gold and brown columns at each side with rectangular gold capitals and bases. The central section below the clock face displays a painted scene, depicting a group of buildings (houses and trees) in green, brown, white, and red tones, set against a blue or purple sky. The lowest section has a rectangular compartment with a glass or painted door, showing another scene featuring a large, white or light-colored building with multiple towers and spires, with green foliage at the base and hints of blue sky and clouds above. The entire clock stands on four short, round legs, and its composition is centered on a plain, light beige background. In the bottom right corner, the name "Dorothina A. Farrington" is handwritten in cursive.
title: Clock
